notes.title: The store page for Disc Creatures WORLD is now open!
notes.content:
The store page for Disc Creatures WORLD, our latest monster-taming RPG, is now open! Featuring over 300 creatures, a vast world to explore, and a strategic battle system, this game offers a fresh adventure. While it's a completely different genre from Infinos Gaiden, we're dedicated to creating a game that many can enjoy. The planned release is set for 2026.

Be sure to check it out—and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3440740/WORLD/

notes.title: Frequently asked questions
notes.content:
·The game does not start
Please try booting from the local folder. If you get a message saying "d3dx9_30.dll is missing" please install DirectX user end runtime.
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=35
It may not be possible to start up for other reasons, so I recommend that you check with the demo version before purchasing.

· About key config, setting
Two items, "Play Infinos Gaiden" and "Launch game editor" are displayed at game startup.  "Launch game editor" starts the key config application.

· Switching Full Screen
Window size, full screen can be selected by key config application.
 Even if you press enter key during game, it will switch.

· Game reset(To title)
If you want to reset the game, please press the R key on the keyboard.

· Screen is distorted at full screen
Please uncheck "Timer sync" in key config. However, in this case operation may be delayed depending on the environment.

Moreover, it does not correspond to achievement, net ranking and multiplayer play. Please note.
